evidence.claim: The configured model_reasoning_effort reaches the request through session settings and is serialized as reasoning.effort; low, medium, high, xhigh and max are sent as exactly those strings. The exec header line 'reasoning effort:' prints the configured label, not the wire value.

rules.note: Expected mapping from client source only; it says nothing about what the backend accepts or computes. ultra resolves to another effort and persistent becomes disabled, so both stay unmapped, as do none, minimal and custom labels. A same-model runtime effort pin, no explicit selection, a model change replacing an unsupported selection, or another step or context fall outside these assumptions.
